articles.text: JÌSHÙYUÁN: Kěyi jìnlai ma?
TECHNICIAN: May I come in?
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Qǐng jìn, kuài qǐng jìnlai zuò.
AMERICAN VISITOR: Come in, please come in and sit down.
JÌSHÙYUÁN: Nín zhǎo wǒ yǒu shì?
TECHNICIAN: Was there something in particular you wanted to see me about?

MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Yìdiǎnr xiǎo shì, wǒ xiǎng hé ni tántan. Wǒ kànle nǐmen zhèipiān wénzhāng, tímù shi "Zhōnghuá Rénmín Gònghéguóde Sānshinián." Wǒ xiǎng jīngguòle zhèi sānshiniánde jiànshè, Zhōngguó jīngjì shuǐpíng yǒule hěn dàde tígāo, biànhuà zhēnshi bù xiǎo.

AMERICAN VISITOR: Just a small matter I wanted to talk with you about. I've read that article of yours called "Thirty Years of the People's Republic of China." I think that after the last thirty years of construction, China's economic level has risen a great deal. The changes have been pretty big.
JÌSHÙYUÁN: Biànhuà shi bù xiǎo, kěshi mùqián wǒmende jīngjì lìliang hái shi bǐ xǔduō xiānjìn guójiā ruòde duō, hái yǒu hěn duō gōngzuò yào zuò.
TECHNICIAN: The changes are big, but at present our economic power is still much weaker than many advanced countries. We still have a lot of work to do.

MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Wénzhāngli shuō, cóng shēngchǎnshang kàn, Yī jiǔ sì jiǔ niánde qīng zhòng gōngyè zài guómín jīngjìli zhǐ zhàn bǎifēnzhī sānshí, xiànzài yǐjing zhàn bǎifēnzhī qīshiwǔ. Zhèiyàng fāzhǎnxiaqu, nóngyè, qīng gōngyè, zhòng gōngyède guānxi zěnmeyàng ne?

AMERICAN VISITOR: In the article it says that from the point of view of production, in 1949 light and heavy industry only occupied thirty percent in the national economy, but now they occupy seventy-five percent. If things keep developing this way, what will happen to the relationship between agriculture, light industry, and heavy industry?
JÌSHÙYUÁN: Zhèiyìdiǎn, wǒmen hěn fàng xīn. Xiànzài, gǎohǎo Sìge Xiàndàihuà shi quánguó rénmínde zhōngxīn gōngzuò. Zài Sìge Xiàndàihuàli, nóngyè xiàndàihuà shi dìyījiàn dà shì.

TECHNICIAN: We're not at all worried about that. Right now, doing a good job of the Four Modernizations is the central task of the people of the whole country. In the Four Modernizations, agricultural modernization is the first big job.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Zhèige zhèngcè shi duìde. Jìn jǐnián lái nóngyè yǒule fāzhǎn, qīng gōngyè, zhòng gōngyè cái néng gēnzhe fāzhǎn. Nóngyè xiàndàihuà shi yíge jīngjì qiángguó zuì qǐmǎde tiáojiàn.

AMERICAN VISITOR: That policy is right. It has only been because there has been development in agriculture in the last few years that light and heavy industry have been able to develop along with it. Agricultural modernization is the minimum requirement for an economic power.
JÌSHÙYUÁN: Shì a! Jiù ná Sìchuān lái shuō, zīyuán nàme duō, kěshi zài qīshí niándài, gōngyè shēngchǎn jiù shi shàngbuqù, hái bú shi yīnwei nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu wèntí.

TECHNICIAN: That's right. Take Sìchuān, for example. It's so full of resources, yet in the seventies, industrial production just couldn't go up — again, it was on account of problems with agricultural production.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Shì ma. Sìchuān rénkǒu zài quánguó zhàn dìyīwèi, chī fàn wèntí shi ge dà wèntí.
AMERICAN VISITOR: Sure. The population of Sìchuān is in first place in the whole country. The food problem is a big one.
JÌSHÙYUÁN: Jìn jǐnián, Sìchuān qíngkuàng biànhuà hěn dà. Nín zhèicì yǒu jīhui qù Sìchuān ma?
TECHNICIAN: In recent years there have been big changes in the situation in Sìchuān. Will you have the chance to go to Sìchuān this trip?
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Yǒu, nín ne, nín yǒu méiyou shíjiān qù?
AMERICAN VISITOR: Yes, and you? Do you have the time to go?
JÌSHÙYUÁN: Lǐngdǎo hái méi shuō, búguò wǒ xiǎng dàgài yǒu jīhui, cóngqián wǒ zài Sìchuān gōngzuòguo liǎngnián, yěxǔ wǒ kěyi gěi nǐmen jièshào jièshao.
TECHNICIAN: The leadership hasn't said yet, but I think I'll probably have the chance. I once worked in Sìchuān for two years. Maybe I could fill you in on it.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Nà tài gǎnxiè le. Guānyú wǒ gāngcái kànde nèipiān wénzhāng, wǒ juéde hěn yǒu yìsi, búguò chángcháng yǒu xiǎode wèntí, děi máfan nǐmen.
AMERICAN VISITOR: We'd be so grateful if you could. About that article I just read: I find it very interesting, but I often have little questions I have to bother you with.
JÌSHÙYUÁN: Méi wèntí, wǒ hěn gāoxìng hé nín duō tántan.
TECHNICIAN: That's no problem. It's my pleasure to talk with you.
